ACT IV OF 2005
ACT IV OF 2005
Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act 2004
An Act to amend the
Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 28th
July, 2005]
No. PAS/LEGIS-B-7/2004, dated
28-7-2005.--The Sindh Civil
Servants (Amendment) Act, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Sindh on 13th May, 2005 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 29th June,
2005, is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-‑
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act XIV of 1973
